items.reason: The 2.5% wash is a gentler place to start than 5% for the look of jaw breakouts, with less dryness, and you can step up later if your skin is comfortable.
A light ceramide moisturizer helps support your skin's moisture level, which scanned on the lower side, so the wash feels more comfortable.
A tinted mineral SPF 50 with iron oxides protects daily and helps keep the look of post-breakout marks from deepening on deeper skin tones.

response.routine_note: Use the wash once a day in the evening, then moisturizer, and build to twice daily only if your skin stays comfortable; apply sunscreen every morning, and keep the wash away from towels and pillowcases it can bleach. If breakouts are painful, keep returning, or leave lasting marks, a dermatologist is the better next step than a stronger product.
